summary: Number.isInteger checks whether a value is a Number with no fractional part.
documentation: Number.isInteger checks whether a value is a Number with no fractional part. It does not convert strings or Booleans to numbers. Nonfinite values are rejected.
returns: A Boolean indicating an integer Number.
caution: Large Numbers may have already lost precision. Use Number.isSafeInteger when exact integer representation matters.
scenarios: Reject fractional item counts in an order form.
Check whole-seat reservations before applying capacity rules.
Validate an imported quantity without accepting numeric-looking text.
title: Validate a whole-number quantity
problem: Return true only when the input is a nonnegative integer Number. Do not accept numeric strings, null or Booleans. Inputs are JSON values with numbers inside the safe-integer range.
goal: Use Number.isInteger() or an equivalent approach demonstrating the same premise.
hint: Combine the integer type check with a nonnegative comparison.
